name: Hearty Food
description: Food heals half as much again, over time, with pale hearts showing where you'll end up. Eating is still one click, and half a heart a second helps even mid-fight. It runs where the world runs, so a server can use it with any client; only a client with the mod too sees the pale hearts.
authors: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic's AI), at Studio Quire
